governance_note: Single source of truth for all quantitative, empirical, and institutional statements in EnerProof. Enforces strict separation between experimentally observed findings, illustrative assumptions, calculated audits, and unestablished claims.

claims.wording: The Baku Higher Oil School 2022 GHG emissions report exhibits a calculated factor-of-10 discrepancy (497.79 metric tonnes calculated vs ~4,978 tonnes reported from 995,575 kWh combined electricity at 0.5 kg CO2/kWh).
claims.source: Baku Higher Oil School Public Sustainability Filing 2022-2023; mathematical product of 995,575 kWh and reported 0.5 kg/kWh factor.
claims.limitations: Demonstrates an arithmetic scaling error in public disclosure; does not infer intentional administrative misconduct or actual operational waste.

claims.wording: Exactly 36 out of 36 monthly records (100%) across electricity and boiler fuel in the published BHOS 2024 report duplicate 2023 values identically.
claims.source: Baku Higher Oil School Public Energy Reports (2023 and 2024 comparative tables).
claims.limitations: Reflects copy-forwarded data in published tables rather than verified operational meter telemetry.

claims.wording: The non-residential electricity tariff in Azerbaijan is illustratively modeled at 0.125 AZN/kWh (12.5 qəpik / ~$0.073/kWh).
claims.source: Tariff (Price) Council of the Republic of Azerbaijan regulatory decree schedule.
claims.limitations: Illustrative applicable rate. Specific institutional tariffs vary by voltage level, metering category, and state budgetary subsidies.

claims.wording: Monthly utility bill regression models cannot reliably detect energy savings below 8-10% at 80% statistical power and 5% false-alarm ceiling.
claims.limitations: Evaluated on 143 completed BDG2 buildings with 12 monthly degrees of freedom. In field applications, monthly utility bills remain insufficient for minor operational retrofits.

claims.wording: Unpooled single buildings fail to achieve 80% statistical detection power for a 5% whole-building energy reduction.
claims.source: BDG2 152-building corrected benchmark; daily ridge weather regression reaches 83.9% detection at 15% simulated savings under synthetic null, but empirical power at 5% savings is only 46.9%. Single-building MDE remains unestablished because historical placebo alarms (22.38%) exceed the 5% target.
claims.limitations: Applies to whole-building counterfactual interval regression. Does not apply to direct equipment-level submetering (IPMVP Option A/B), where power is isolated.

claims.wording: Aggregating an ESCO portfolio of K=20 buildings raises empirical detection power for a 10% saving to 82.0%, bounded by an intra-site residual correlation floor (rho ≈ 0.33).
claims.limitations: Observed on same-campus/regional university building clusters sharing weather microclimates. Does not guarantee 82% power for arbitrary unaligned user portfolios without covariance verification.

claims.wording: Dormitory behavioral awareness campaigns without automated controls consistently deliver only 1.1% to 1.5% persistent whole-building energy savings.
claims.source: Peer-reviewed building energy behavior literature (Delmas et al., Nature Climate Change; BDG2 residence sub-cohort).
claims.limitations: Behavioral nudges decay rapidly without structural automation. Savings >5% require physical equipment retrofits or automated scheduling.

claims.wording: Research cohort provenance: The exploratory benchmark evaluated 149 buildings (59 dormitories, 2.61M hours). The corrected Experiment 2 cohort screened 152 buildings (82 lodging, 70 education) with 9 test-period dropouts recorded as cohort abstentions.
claims.source: Building Data Genome 2 (Miller et al., Scientific Data, 2020); EnerProof Experiment 2 audit pipeline.
claims.limitations: The 152 buildings represent both university education facilities and non-university commercial/residential lodging; they cannot be generalized as all university campuses.

claims.wording: EnerProof commercial traction and customer relationships in Azerbaijan are in the proposed development stage.
claims.limitations: EnerProof has not executed a live commercial energy-saving contract or confirmed paid customers. All institutional pilots are proposed.

claims.wording: EnerProof determinations are analytical decision-support outputs based on modeled counterfactual baselines; they do not constitute formal regulatory certification, statutory audit endorsement, or legal proof of causal attribution.
claims.limitations: Formal certification requires licensed energy auditor sign-off and on-site engineering commissioning.
